scope.applies_to: All canonical exercise generation and alias-resolved requests; no additional animation batch authorized by documenting this contract.
scope.current_five_status: review batch001; repaired0001candidate awaiting user review; other four prototypes retained
scope.integration: Contract plus prepared per-exercise context packets plus the existing first-five authoring entrypoint guard; not an automatic rig solver or proof all catalogue exercises are valid.

corpus.count_note: Reason counts overlap; source gaps, authored proposal readiness and production acceptance are different concepts.

evidence_status_policy.source: Verbatim catalogue/asset metadata with path/pointer/hash; not independent truth validation.
evidence_status_policy.authored_choice: Reversible design/staging interpretation with rationale and scope; never source-verified merely because implemented.
evidence_status_policy.measured_unapproved: A measured value without an accepted technique/range/contact interpretation; not an acceptance threshold.
evidence_status_policy.fixed_measured: A specific implemented correction with a receipt covering that exact property; no wider inference.
evidence_status_policy.implemented_sampled: Implemented and sampled, with declared frames/platform and remaining unmeasured behavior.
evidence_status_policy.open: Reported or unresolved; must retain remediation and evidence and cannot be silently treated as passed.
evidence_status_policy.not_run: Required evidence has not been collected for this exercise/asset revision.
evidence_status_policy.not_applicable: Explicit reason why a conditional check does not apply.
evidence_status_policy.closure_rule: Only evidence for the changed property and asset revision can close its issue; global floor/bone-loop passes do not close 0001 contacts/arms.
no_claims: No physiological activation curves or EMG claims.
No universal validated joint limits or inferred apparatus dimensions.
No automatic production-ready status from a source brief or context packet.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Resolve the requested ID to one of the existing canonical catalogue IDs; carry complete instructions, evidence, original record/hash, alias resolution and all source gaps into the authoring context.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Prepared packet resolves an existing ID, preserves all source steps/reasons and includes the baseline requirement IDs and relevant known issues.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Keep source facts, reversible authored choices, measured-but-unapproved values and unresolved decisions separate. Do not treat source completeness or a staging proposal as production acceptance.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Each critical choice cites source evidence or an explicit authoring basis; unresolved source blockers remain visible, and conflict dispositions are recorded.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Use repository exercise text with notices and the accepted CC0 continuous body. Do not open, feed to AI, trace, copy or derive animations from Gym Visual media.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Inputs/provenance identify authorized text/body sources and exclude restricted exercise media; required notices are retained.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Preserve the accepted continuous CC0 skin, source geometry and atlas binding. Do not recreate clothing, add disconnected muscle shells or generate new all-body textures that reintroduce seams.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Confirm source signature, one connected body, finite weights and unchanged intended topology; inspect posed skin for seams and intersections.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Create an exercise-specific action; remove inherited source actions and do not reuse the former squat trajectory or a generic bobbing cycle for unrelated exercises.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Clip/action ID, phase order and sampled geometry correspond to this exercise and its recorded authoring choices.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Name actual evaluated-skin contact patches and supporting surfaces per phase. Global minZ, a single bone target or whole-group extrema cannot by themselves establish contact.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: For each active support, inspect signed distance distribution, near-contact area/fraction, penetration and tangential drift in a declared world frame, on native and runtime skins.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Solve simultaneous pelvis/heel/sole/palm supports together with lumbar clearance and joint pose. Do not translate the whole body by an illustrative glute-proxy gap.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Intended contacts share the declared support plane/geometry without back/limb penetration; lifted contacts stay clear in their noncontact phases; review start/mid/top and transitions.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Define exercise-specific joint/segment targets, angle conventions, poles, ranges, phase timing and rotation continuity. Unsupported numerical limits remain null/unapproved.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Measurements state reference frame/basis; no unexplained target, elbow/knee flip, limb twist or self-intersection; source torso angles are not relabeled validated anatomical limits.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Specify palm orientation, grip or open-hand contact and articulated fingers together with shoulder/elbow/wrist pose. For 0001 resolve palm/head placement and natural arm bends.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Review both hands and elbows at start/mid/top; check actual palm/head/support clearances, wrist orientation and intersections, not only rig endpoints.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Where the exercise hops, author grounded compression, forefoot push-off, flight and controlled landing with coherent knee/hip/travel and free-leg behavior.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Sample every support-state transition and inspect actual decoded/runtime motion from complementary views; no planted-foot sliding or rigid whole-body bobbing.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Retain catalogue labels; explicitly record illustrative main/additional/stretch overrides and actual anatomical L/R sides per phase. Keep inactive skin uniformly neutral with no inactive fibers.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Only selected working/support/stretch regions receive role detail; red main, amber additional and cyan stretch are not EMG or measured instantaneous recruitment.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Resolve exact region IDs and review group/proxy meaning. Surface/deep/group/proxy/systemic/unsupported statuses remain explicit; do not invent localized patches for unsupported/systemic labels.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Unknown names are flagged; region references exist; selected region groups match the intended concept or an explicit proxy explanation. Focused biceps selection excludes biceps_femoris.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Choose recommended views that collectively expose movement, relevant contacts and selected visible muscle regions; add views for occlusion rather than mirrored duplicates.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Coverage records name region/side/phase and a useful view, or an explicit deep/unsupported/occlusion limitation; review actual images/runtime.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Disable cast shadows, cavity/AO and specular overlays in native and runtime rendering; do not bake background, fake cavities or all-body fibers into the selected atlas.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Inspect overlapping limbs and selected/unselected pixels in actual native/runtime output; verify lighting flags and uniform inactive body.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Preserve atlas UV channel 1 on every replacement runtime texture and retain source-index correspondence across glTF UV splits.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Loaded material maps report channel 1; original-source vertex lookup resolves; selected pixels stay on their intended deformed regions.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Use 2048x1024 runtime atlases with a lazy neutral/active color cache, disposal and stale-load protection. Share one rig/skeleton/mixer update across synchronized views.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Probe actual runtime dimensions, loaded color states and stale switches; one model/skeleton/mixer and one pose update per frame; distinguish skeleton/internal GPU textures from color cache.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Check actual exported runtime against Blender and acknowledge runtime cage versus native corrective-smooth/subdivision differences. Bone parity alone does not validate skin contact or appearance.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Compare sampled bones plus relevant evaluated surface patches, atlas placement, contact appearance and visibility in both paths.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Require actual transparent canvas and WebM-alpha masters; MP4 is explicitly an opaque fallback. CSS checker/white/dark backgrounds are not alpha evidence.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Verify alpha context, null scene background, zero clear alpha and empty corner pixels; decode actual WebM frames with alpha and confirm opaque body; label MP4 fallback correctly.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Check root/joint/contact continuity and appropriate velocity across loop boundaries, then decode the actual delivered files and inspect seam motion.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Record hashes, frame count/rate, dimensions, duration, audio state, decoded frames and seam comparison; a bone endpoint or encoder flag alone cannot pass.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Open at the exercise recommended camera(s); provide finger orbit, pinch zoom, reset to recommended camera, continued motion during camera interaction and no panning. Retain extra views when muscles are hidden.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: In the actual runtime, record camera change for orbit/zoom, stable pan target, recommended-view reset and advancing animation time; distinguish emulated touch from a physical-device check.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Preserve open issues and actual evidence scope. Existing-source checks are reusable only for unchanged inputs; no catalogue-wide production, anatomy, coaching or EMG certification is implied.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Readiness lists unresolved fields and issue IDs; issue closure names changed asset/hash, per-contact/pose visual receipts and relevant runtime/decoded checks. Remediation drafts retain their open status.

per_exercise_intake_schema.title: Completed exercise animation production intake

canonical_id.description: Must resolve to a record_kind=canonical ID in briefs.jsonl.gz; a regex match alone is insufficient.

production_ready.description: False by default. A prepared context packet does not set this true.

per_exercise_intake_schema.description: Shape validation only. Canonical membership, source pointers, thresholds, patch landmarks, issue closure and visual/runtime acceptance require the semantic checks in this contract; the deliberately unfilled template is not a completed intake.

5965.movement_interpretation: Two lateral shuffle steps toward screen-left (anatomical right in the current front view), then return. Exact source one-two footfalls remain unspecified.
5965.interpretation_scope: Selected pilot only; preserve canonical movement_pattern_unspecified gap.
5965.muscle_override: Cardiovascular system has no localized atlas patch. Current visible-load art direction uses quads/calves with additional core/glutes.
5965.direction_requirement: Declare screen/world/anatomical frames; never infer anatomical side from screen-left alone.

5915.arm_intent: Palms down, fingers forward, elbows track backward; verify actual palm/forearm surfaces.
5915.choice_note: The delivered pilot uses left raised leg; earlier right-first source-normalization proposal is not an instruction to mirror the current asset.

5887.timing_note: Short preview hold, not the source five-breath hold performed in real time.
5887.choice_note: Stretch color is cyan; do not relabel the source hamstring target as measured primary contraction.

0001.joint_note: Catalogue torso target is approximately45degrees; define its reference plane as an explicit authoring choice. This is not a validated hip/lumbar joint limit.
0001.measurement_note: Earlier elbow internal angle about50.0494degrees was unapproved; the original proxy-gap diagnosis is retained separately. The repaired candidate uses authored original-vertex support/clearance patches with a43.67degree hip-to-neck top inclination. Native and actualGLB surfaces must pass their scoped checks; user review remains pending.
0001.forbidden_shortcut: No blanket whole-body downward translation based on glute-proxy minima.

candidate_authoring_choices.pelvis_foot_solver: Hip path and torso curl are authored with independently planted footIK; lumbar clearance checked.
candidate_authoring_choices.hands: Open elbows, separated hands behind the head, revised wrist spacing/head rest/finger bend; fingertips near posterior scalp without a neck-pull grip.
candidate_authoring_choices.landmark_status: Authored illustrative skin patches, not clinical ischial landmarks.

9066.authored_pattern: Eight hops: forward/center, left/center, back/center, right/center; direction frame must be declared.
9066.neutral_side_requirement: Do not apply the loaded calf/quads/glute mask to the free right leg by a bilateral default.

known_open_issues.summary: Feet and pelvis do not read as resting on one floor. Existing global floor and bone-loop checks are insufficient.
required_remediation: Select and review true left/right heel/sole and pelvic support patches; illustrative glute masks are diagnostic proxies, not accepted ischial landmarks.
Jointly solve pelvic/heel support, knee pose and lumbar/back clearance; do not lower the whole character by the glute-proxy gap.
Measure each evaluated patch on native and exported skin with justified tolerances and inspect start/mid/top plus contact transitions from side/oblique views.
Retain the open status until numerical and visual evidence cover the actual intended contact patches.

evidence.summary: Frames0/30/60: foot minima about0.003276m; glute-core proxies about0.06286–0.06545m with no proxy vertices within1cm floor. This is not a whole-pelvis clearance measurement.
Sampled global/body and coarse hand/foot bounds plus exact joint loop closure do not certify pelvic contact.
Repaired review candidate:18native/linear phase samples, authored pelvic/heel/sole/lumbar patches and signed palm/fingertip/head clearance. Source binding and other four actions unchanged.
The exact deliveredGLB must pass original-index support comparisons and signed nearest distances to its actual exported head triangles; joint-only matching is insufficient.

known_open_issues.remediation_draft_exception: Only an explicitly authorized remediation draft may use the existing entrypoint override; it does not close this issue.

known_open_issues.summary: Hands/head relationship and arm bends near the head look unnatural.
required_remediation: Review shoulder, elbow, wrist, palm and finger geometry together with actual head/ear clearance.
Keep the source hands-behind-head cue without head/ear intersections, crossed forearms, wrist twists or a visual neck pull.
Inspect both sides at start/mid/top on native and runtime skin; record exercise-specific angle conventions/targets and their review basis.
Do not approve the pose merely because the internal elbow angle repeats or the animation loops exactly.

evidence.summary: Internal elbow angles approximately50.0494degrees at all three samples are measured but unapproved, not a validated range.
Repaired review candidate:18native/linear phase samples, authored pelvic/heel/sole/lumbar patches and signed palm/fingertip/head clearance. Source binding and other four actions unchanged.
The exact deliveredGLB must pass original-index support comparisons and signed nearest distances to its actual exported head triangles; joint-only matching is insufficient.

required_remediation: Verify the same recommended-camera, finger-orbit, pinch-zoom, reset, continued-animation and no-pan behavior in the actual application integration.
Collect physical iOS/Android device evidence for those interactions and clearly separate it from the existing390x850 Chromium/Metal emulation receipt.

evidence.summary: Current receipt passes actual Chromium/Metal touch events at390x850 for dual-view orbit/zoom, no pan, recommended reset and continued animation; not physical device/app evidence.

known_open_issues.scope_note: Nonblocking for clip authoring. Only real-app integration and physical-device verification remain open; the review-player behavior is already implemented and emulation-verified.

resolved_findings.summary: Biceps mapping now selects only biceps.L/R and excludes biceps_femoris/hamstring regions.

evidence.summary: Rebuilt atlas asset readback QA passes; this still does not certify all muscle-label physiology.

resolved_findings.limit: Reference validity and this focused semantic guard do not certify physiological correctness of all57 names.

optional_flags.--require-ready: Write packets, then exit2 if source/known blocking issues remain; never implies production approval.

preparation.authoring_guard: Current first-five entrypoint loads blocking known issues before opening the Blender source. An explicitly authorized remediation draft can use -- --allow-known-issues; ordinary regeneration must not hide known defects.

validation_scope: This JSON is a production/intake contract, not an assertion that future poses, thresholds, contact landmarks, controls or all catalogue records have been validated.

authoring_self_check.scope: Syntax, existing file/pointer references, corpus membership/counts and receipt readback only; not fresh animation/contact/playback testing.
